# Unit-format golden vectors: UNIT, CONFIGS and END records, the MIME
# type and a chunked stream, all as hex. tests/golden_units.rs computes
# each from the inputs named here. STRIMS_GOLDEN=update rewrites the
# outputs.
#
# tracks: the configs of track 1 (H.264 avcC, 640x360, 90 kHz) and track
# 2 (AAC LC AudioSpecificConfig, stereo, 48 kHz; or an Opus OpusHead,
# stereo, pre-skip 312).
tracks avcc=0164001fffe1000b6764001facd940a02ff95001000468ce3c80 asc=1190 opus_head=4f707573486561640102380180bb0000000000
#
# unit: a UNIT record of the header fields, gop_back and payload.
unit track=1 key=1 seq=0 config=0 dts=0 pts=6000 unix_ms=1793275200000 gop_back=60 payload=00010203 hex=023c0d0101000000e05d8088c0f8b06800010203
unit track=1 key=0 seq=301 config=2 dts=903000 pts=900000 unix_ms=1793275210033 gop_back=70000 payload=1011 hex=02f0a204100100ad0202b09d6eef2ee2a4c1f8b0681011
unit track=2 key=1 seq=47 config=0 dts=48128 pts=48128 unix_ms=1793275201003 gop_back=1234 payload=a0a1a2 hex=02d2090e02012f0080f00500d697c0f8b068a0a1a2
#
# configs: a CONFIGS record of tracks v, a, o, va or vo, each with its
# version and next seq; gop_back 0 is a GOP's sync record.
configs tracks=va versions=0,0 next=0,0 gop_back=0 hex=010000250100006176633190bf051a0164001fffe1000b6764001facd940a02ff95001000468ce3c800d0200006d70346180f702021190
configs tracks=va versions=3,1 next=300,470 gop_back=2048 hex=01801000260103ac026176633190bf051a0164001fffe1000b6764001facd940a02ff95001000468ce3c800e0201d6036d70346180f702021190
configs tracks=a versions=0 next=94 gop_back=0 hex=0100000d02005e6d70346180f702021190
configs tracks=vo versions=0,0 next=0,0 gop_back=0 hex=010000250100006176633190bf051a0164001fffe1000b6764001facd940a02ff95001000468ce3c801e0200004f70757380f702134f707573486561640102380180bb0000000000
configs tracks=o versions=2 next=50 gop_back=4096 hex=018020001e0202324f70757380f702134f707573486561640102380180bb0000000000
#
# end: an END record.
end hex=030000
#
# mime: the MIME type of a stream of the tracks.
mime tracks=va value=video/x.strims-units;codecs="avc1.64001f,mp4a.40.2"
mime tracks=v value=video/x.strims-units;codecs="avc1.64001f"
mime tracks=vo value=video/x.strims-units;codecs="avc1.64001f,Opus"
mime tracks=o value=video/x.strims-units;codecs="Opus"
#
# stream: the script through a UnitWriter of frame-byte frames, signed
# early after unit sign_after into units of unit_frames frames, and
# finished: an END record after the last unit.
stream frame=64 unit_frames=4 sign_after=4 
stream frame=4096 unit_frames=1 sign_after=4
